rules.statement: The rule of succession applicable to Buddhist temples is presumed to be the sissyanu sisya paramparawa, and the onus of proving any other rule of succession lies with the person alleging it.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under our law, it will be presumed that the rule of succession applicable to Buddhist temples is the sissyanu sisya paramparawa. The onus of proving any other rule of succession is on the person alleging it."

meta.parties: Kamburugamuwa Piyananda Terunnanse v. Uyangoda Sumanajothi Terunnanse
